|lore='''Gambler'''. Lando Calrissian posed as a guard for Jabba in order to spy on the Hutt. Feared that he would be recognized by some of Jabba’s companions.
|game_text=Deploys only to a Tatooine site as an Undercover spy. Once during each control phase, if Undercover, may relocate your character at a related site to Lando’s site (for free). Once per game, may deploy Vibro-Ax on Lando for free from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
